text:
maria-partners: Quick ask — we need the final hardware partner price envelope + auction mapping for the cost model by EOD. Specifically: SKU floor, reserved price per GPU-hour, typical spot mean & variance, 24h eviction %, min commit (months), and any auction bid ladder tiers. Also indicate regional deltas and billing lag. CSV spec below. @marketplace-bot can you pull current marketplace listings so we have SKU ids? :eyes:

marketplace-bot: pulled 12 SKUs for the partners tagged in workspace. link: https://drive.redwood.ai/partners/marketplace-export-1764012345.csv :robot_face:

jake-sales: VoltCloud sent a spreadsheet this morning — will scrub PII and drop a cleaned CSV into the drive by 15:00 PT. they included: reserved price, spot historical mean, spot eviction 1d/7d, commit_min_months.

li-eng: thanks. For ingestion please follow this CSV schema (exact columns):

```csv
partner,sku,region,reserved_price_usd_per_gpu_hour,spot_mean_usd_per_gpu_hour,spot_stddev,spot_eviction_24h_pct,min_commit_months,auction_tiers_json,latency_premium_ms,billing_lag_days
VoltCloud,vc-a5000,us-west1,1.35,0.45,0.12,4.2,1,"[{\"tier\":\"high\",\"mult\":1.2},{\"tier\":\"low\",\"mult\":0.8}]",5,7
```

li-eng: ingestion command we'll run once CSV is uploded:

```bash
./tools/partner-ingest --file partners/marketplace-export-1764012345.csv --env prod --dry-run
```

nina-ops: Heads-up: we need reserved->spot conversion windows and any guaranteed grace/eviction notice windows from partners. If a partner has a 48h eviction grace, that materially changes our preemptible fallback planning. Also call out if there are regional embargoes for bursting.

chris-finance: Also include invoicing cadence and whether partners do monthly-prorated credits for evictions (we model credits as refunds to reserved bucket). If billing lag > 14d we need to adjust cashflow model.

jake-sales: VoltCloud flagged one SKU as NDA-protected pricing for EU region only — I can include a masked row (price=REDACTED) and a note in the CSV. Is that acceptable for the ingester?

li-eng: masked rows are fine, but we need a partner column with a boolean "price_masked" so the model knows to ignore those SKUs in public cost estimates. Example: price_masked=true

maria-partners: Good call. Also, please annotate auction ladder semantics — some partners use absolute price floors, others use % above spot for "bid tiers". We need consistent normalization. Put raw auction_tiers_json and we'll canonicalize in ingestion.

marketplace-bot: added marketplace metadata: listing_id, sku_id, partner_id to the export.

nina-ops: One more ops ask: please include typical observed latency premium for reserved vs spot GPUs (ms) if partner provides it. We'll use that to compute tail-latency SLO impacts.

jake-sales: uploading cleaned CSV now: https://drive.redwood.ai/partners/voltcloud-cleaned-1764012345.csv 

li-eng: starting dry-run ingest now. command output snippet: 

```
[ingest] parsing 1/12 rows... ok
[ingest] parsing 2/12 rows... ok
[ingest] masked row 3/12 -> price_masked=true
[ingest] queued 11 SKUs for acceptance tests
```

chris-finance: If we get all partner CSVs by 17:00 I'll run the multi-scenario run (reserved-heavy, spot-heavy, mixed-auction) tonight and share model outputs tomorrow AM. Need confirmation on billing_lag_days field though — some partners gave a range (7-30). Use conservative max?

maria-partners: Use conservative (max) for cashflow. Also note partners asking for "commit cliff" smoothing (they prefer prorated conversion instead of binary cliffs). Nina — can you capture cliff smoothing options for the playbook?

nina-ops: Will add a short section to ops playbook: recommended smoothing = linear 30d ramp on commit reductions; fallback policy = immediate preemptible drop after grace window. I'll paste the draft after I finish.

jake-sales: FYI partner asked that we avoid publicizing SKU-level price deltas in announcements. They agreed to share aggregated ranges for marketing.

maria-partners: copy. We'll keep marketing-safe aggregates for any joint announcement. Legal/PR loop in separately.

chris-finance: last ask — include partner-level monthly committed GPU-hours if available. Our costing engine uses that to estimate utilization dilution.

maria-partners: thanks team. Action items: Jake -> upload cleaned CSVs (in progress); Li -> run ingest dry-run and report errors; Nina -> add cliff-smoothing note; Chris -> run scenario runs if data in by 17:00. I'll follow up with NDA addendum note for VoltCloud. :thumbsup:
